summary: Verified iteration_25 additions on Web Dojo (frontend only, backend skipped): (1) Layers Paste-to-Many works for both static gradient and hover FX; (2) Style library saves, applies, deletes, and persists across reload via localStorage 'webdojo_style_library'; (3) Regression: single copy/paste, no-effect gate, layers Effects filter, effect badges and jump-to-effected all still work. Zero console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: TextEffectsPanel.saveToLibrary uses `id: 'lib-' + Date.now()`. Two saves within the same millisecond (e.g., via keyboard-repeat) will produce colliding ids, breaking the delete/apply mapping. Consider appending Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) or reusing the same `uid()` helper used for element ids.

TextEffectsPanel.libPreview() renders user-copied style strings via dangerouslySetInnerHTML into a div (`
`). While the source is the internal clipboard, a hostile HTML block dropped on canvas could seed a style object containing `"` and break/inject markup. Serializing the entry via React inline style prop (or escaping quotes) would be safer.
LayersPanel.pasteMany() shows toast even when `onApplyStyleToIds` no-ops due to missing ids (filter shrinks list). Consider surfacing the actual applied count returned from the parent.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral canvas blocks (3x Large Header, then post-reload 2x Large Header) plus a localStorage entry 'webdojo_style_library' with a single 'MyNeon' chip; chip was deleted at the end of the test to leave storage clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 25 PASS matrix (0 errors):
- Paste-to-Many (gradient): Added 3 Large Header blocks (block-cmp-header-lrg). Selected #1, insp-tab-textfx -> textfx-static-sunset, then textfx-copy. Checked layer-check-<idB> + layer-check-<idC>; batch bar 'layers-batch-bar' shows '2 selected'; 'layers-paste-many' enabled with label 'Paste to 2'. After click, both target headers' inline style now contains linear-gradient, background-clip:text and -webkit-text-fill-color:transparent; toast 'Style pasted onto 2 elements' fires.
- Paste-to-Many (hover): Copied textfx-hover-lift; clicked layers-clear-select (batch bar hidden). Re-checked two rows and paste-many; both root <header> tags received a wd-tfx-* class and exactly one <style data-wd-tfx> was present in <head> with the hover rule.
- Style library: Copied textfx-static-neon, typed 'MyNeon' in style-lib-name, clicked style-lib-save; toast 'Saved "MyNeon" to library'; a chip appeared with testid style-lib-lib-<ts>. Chip preview thumbnail renders via libPreview (background sanitized). Clicking the chip with a selection applied it (toast 'Applied "MyNeon"', target header inline style got text-shadow). localStorage 'webdojo_style_library' JSON contained the entry.
- Persistence: page.reload() -> chip still rendered under Text FX; delete via style-lib-delete-lib-<ts> removed it and localStorage entry cleared.
- Empty-clipboard: after reload, checking a row shows batch bar but layers-paste-many is disabled (getFxClip() null).
- No-effect gate: textfx-copy on a plain header -> toast 'This element has no effect or shape style to copy'; textfx-paste stays disabled.
- Regressions: single textfx-copy / textfx-paste applies gradient across two elements; layers-filter-fx shows 'Effects · N'; layer-fx-<id> badges visible; clicking a badge selects the element (row gets border-blue-500).
DOM tip for future scripts: canvas-el-<id> wraps a Canvas.jsx <div dangerouslySetInnerHTML> so the header is at n.querySelector('header') NOT n.firstElementChild (that returns the injected wrapper div).
